_comment: Every input to a RotomLab artifact release, pinned by version and SHA-256. Nothing is fetched that is not listed here, and nothing listed here is used without verifying its digest first.
_decomps_comment: hostToolsId is the artifact ID RotomLab's manifest already uses for this decomp's host-tool bundle. Pinned here rather than derived, because emit-fragment.sh writes it into games.<id>.hostTools and manifest.validate() rejects a game referencing an ID that does not exist — so a wrong value fails loudly instead of quietly adding an unreferenced entry.

posix._comment: Built from source under musl. GPLv3+, so recording the upstream URL discharges corresponding-source.

busybox._comment: 1.35.0 is the newest official static build upstream publishes (2022-01-17); there is no 1.36 binary. GPLv2-only, which unlike GPLv3 has no provision for merely pointing at an upstream URL, so the source tarball is mirrored alongside the binary.
busybox._applets_comment: The applet names RotomLab's manifest symlinks to this binary. Recorded here because the check has to live where the binary is fetched: a missing applet surfaces as command-not-found deep inside a decomp build. mirror.sh asserts every name is in `busybox --list`, and emit-fragment.sh asserts the merged manifest names no applet outside this verified list, so the two cannot drift apart unnoticed.

devkitarm._comment: devkitARM is a metapackage with no files of its own (ISIZE 0). These five packages are its dependency closure, spanning two repo paths: arch-specific under packages/linux/x86_64/, any-arch under packages/. Each is a pacman .pkg.tar.zst carrying .PKGINFO/.MTREE/.BUILDINFO at its root, which must be dropped when merging the extracted trees.
devkitarm._buildscripts_comment: The commit the tag resolved to on 2026-08-01. Recorded alongside the tag because a tag can be moved and a corresponding-source offer that points at a moving target is not an offer. Verified: devkitPro/buildscripts has no GitHub *release* for this tag, only the tag itself, so SOURCES.md must link to /tree/ and not /releases/tag/.
